name: Kuroune Belduke
original_name: クローネ・ベルデューク
source:
[Spoiler]Darklaw was born Eve Belduke, daughter of Newton Belduke, and was the childhood friend of Espella Cantabella. After a terrible fire killed the entire population of their town, she was forced to change her name to Darklaw in order to hide the truth about the incident from Cantabella, and aid her friend's father, Arthur Cantabella, in fabricating a new town called Labyrinthia.[/Spoiler]

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Darklaw]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
